# Security Policy

## Project Scope

This repository contains an independently designed and implemented professional portfolio case study.

It is not a production service, client deployment, employer system, or live commercial environment. Public examples and evidence are intended to use synthetic or public-safe data. Credentials, access tokens, private API keys, and production customer data must not be committed to this repository.

## Supported Version

The current `main` branch and the latest published release represent the actively maintained public version of this project. Older historical snapshots are not maintained separately.

## Reporting a Security Issue

If you identify a potentially exposed credential, sensitive-data issue, unsafe configuration, or other security concern, do not publish the sensitive details in a public GitHub Issue.

Report the concern privately by email:

m.mahdi.eqbal@gmail.com

Please include:

- the repository name;
- the affected file, path, or commit;
- a concise description of the issue;
- reproduction details when applicable;
- the potential impact;
- recommended remediation, if known.

Do not include active credentials, personal data, or other sensitive values in the report.

## Response and Remediation

Reports will be reviewed on a best-effort basis. Confirmed issues may result in credential revocation, history cleanup, configuration changes, documentation updates, or a new release.

## Public Issues

General bugs, documentation problems, and non-sensitive technical feedback may be submitted through GitHub Issues.
